info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Party By Param1-spec
info.description: The Party Lookup API enables users to retrieve detailed information about specific parties using unique identifiers. This endpoint allows clients to access essential party data, including contact details and routing profiles, by providing a designated parameter. Typical consumers include banking applications and customer relationship management systems that require quick access to party data for account management or transaction processing. With efficient querying capabilities, this API enhances user experience by streamlining data access.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific party routing profile.
get.description: Fetches the details of a party routing profile identified by the given ID. This endpoint returns the necessary information related to the party's routing profile for further processing or display.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the routing profile of a specific party. This body structure is essential for the operation to fetch relevant information about the party's routing profile based on the provided identifier. Ensure that the request conforms to the defined schema for successful processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the party routing profile.
